cacheHint.note: cache by the JCS-canonical policy_parameters hash only; never by wall-clock or session

description: Recomputes a redline review from scratch: the diff (from the pasted original+revised text), the diff_receipt's execution_hash, every hunk_receipt's digest/execution_hash/chain-link (in the order supplied -- entries may be minted by an agent, a human, or both interleaved), the disposition_receipt's execution_hash, and the accepted-text digest. Returns valid:true/false, a per-check breakdown, and broken_hunk (the zero-based index of the first divergence, or null) -- never trusts a bundle claim without checking it against a fresh recomputation.

bundle.description: The redline receipt bundle to verify.

diff_receipt.description: The diff receipt (from redline_diff or the browser workbench).

disposition_receipt.description: The closing disposition receipt binding the accepted-text digest.

hunk_receipts.description: Ordered hunk disposition receipts, one per hunk index.

name: redline_verify
title: Verify a redline receipt bundle against the original + revised text
